propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with a reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE on unrelated tickets whose relation graph walks through the orphan directory.

The empty directory artifact persists across git operations because git cannot track empty directories, making it invisible to git status and unreachable by pulling history, so it exists only in local clones.
The error message names the broken directory (e.g. 0de5-6db1-8058-4e80), not the ticket being reviewed (e.g. 5267), masking the true root cause and misleading debugging efforts.
Removing the orphan event-less directory resolves the INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets without any other code changes, proving causation.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, and the writer must not create directories before staging its first event to prevent new orphans.
